title: Cross-Domain Generator Mixer: Concept Specification
description: Cross-Domain Generator Mixer — Concept Specification. Combines two or more generators to produce a new composite capability, then checks compatibility and usefulness.
body: The Cross-Domain Generator Mixer (catalog entry 727, Apex Mixed Systems) is a proposed Signature-original capability for the JAH Network apex simulator-generator family. Combines two or more generators to produce a new composite capability, then checks compatibility and usefulness. This concept specification states the problem it solves, the class of inputs it accepts, and the class of outputs it promises. It is designed to live in the Signature ecosystem alongside the other apex tools: it exchanges tool definitions, simulation results, and evidence packs through the shared apex registry, and every artifact it produces is expected to carry its provenance, tests, and recorded results with it. This record describes a PROPOSED capability, not a completed product. Nothing here claims the tool has been built, independently verified, or deployed. Design rule: a generated tool is NOT marked operational until it has a defined interface, a successful build, meaningful tests, and recorded results.
